Body.Content:
Team members can now begin their time entry process from their assigned or booked projects and tasks, making their time entries more aligned with staffing and reducing manual effort overall. When you select time entry creation from the new Projects and Tasks view, you're redirected to the time entry grid where your entries are prepopulated based on assigned or booked hours.

Business Value:

This feature saves you time by eliminating manual entry. It prepopulates details with your current staffing, so you track time more accurately and focus on work that drives greater impact.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/time/enhanced-team-member-experience

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: June CY2026
